summary: 22-year-old male from Highlands Ranch fell from a cliff while cliff diving at Seaman Reservoir; body recovered from the water about an hour later by the Larimer County Dive Rescue Team after a multi-agency response (Friday-verified)
responding_agency: Larimer County Dive Rescue Team; Larimer County Sheriff's Office Emergency Services; LCSO Patrol; Poudre Fire Authority; Larimer County Coroner's Office
notes: North Forty News story published 2015-06-13 describing the June 12 incident; identity not released in the story
